title: Membership Desk Cross-Notice: The Credit Share for a Long-Standing Member and Holder
content:
The share at which a credit is taken on the figure it rests on under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is raised for customers whose membership in the Belrose Circle Membership Programme stands above Belrose Circle Gold, and how far depends on how long they have held the traded piece.

## The notice

Where the customer's membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold and they have held the piece for at least ten years, the share is eighty-five percent (85 percent). Where their membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold and they have held the piece for less than ten years, the share is seventy-eight percent (78 percent). Otherwise the share is the one the programme publishes for a current appraised value.

A membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold when its tier is Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. Ten years is counted as 3650 calendar days from the date the piece was originally bought, as recorded on the registration, to the handling date.

## Tier and years together

| Membership tier | Calendar days the piece has been held | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | 3650 or more | 85 percent |
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | 3649 or fewer | 78 percent |
| Gold, Silver or Member | any | the programme's published share for a current appraised value |

A piece bought exactly 3650 days before the handling date has been held for at least ten years; one bought 3649 days before has not.

## Readings on a figure of 20000 USD

- A Belrose Circle Founders' Club member who has held the piece 4000 days: 17000.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Platinum member who has held it 900 days: 15600.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Gold member, whatever the years: the programme's published share applies.
